item.title: UMD Men’s & Women’s Basketball Both Clinch NSIC North Title, Bulldog Women Earn First Round Bye
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- Both the UMD men’s and women’s basketball teams claimed the NSIC North Division title this past weekend, following victories against MSU-Moorhead. The Bulldog women also clinched a first round bye in the upcoming NSIC tournament. As for the UMD men, they will host Minot State this upcoming Wednesday in first round action. item.title: Makenzie Cole Becomes All-Time Saves Leader at CSS, Also Named MIAC Defender of the Week
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- Former Grand Rapids/Greenway goaltender and current St. Scholastica goaltender Makenzie Cole ended her Saints career by achieving history. Cole became the all-time saves leader in Scholastica’s weekend series against St. Catherine.
